{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute total revenue per channel, stratified by customer_segment
revenue_by_channel_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute total revenue per channel (aggregated)
channel_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Compute average revenue per order per channel, stratified by customer_segment
avg_revenue_by_channel_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Display results
revenue_by_channel_segment, channel_revenue, avg_revenue_by_channel_segment"}
